title: the Fens Rising Again
author: Coral Reyes
blurb: August Whitlock, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
